description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git repository behaviors related to branch checkouts, especially focusing on the 'unborn' branch state. It defines several test cases with setup commands and assertions to verify Git's handling of various checkout scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes a series of commands, and verifies conditions.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository in a specified directory.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the subsequent command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files and verifies they are identical.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
